notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 5acdbc55 - Fix prepush gate runner resolution
  • d7307da4 - test(mcp): update the deploy-config guard for production's flipped kill switch
[Compare with previous version](/regenai-gitlab/regenai-digital/cleo/-/merge_requests/1125/diffs?diff_id=1950420790&start_sha=5089fdf6fd5ddbe3939aabf2b070f26ce82b4062)

## Pipeline green — [#2744006946](https://gitlab.com/regenai-gitlab/regenai-digital/cleo/-/pipelines/2744006946)

`mcp-connector-tests` initially failed — not a bug, a deliberate guard. `test_deploy_config.py` pinned production's `MCP_CONNECTOR_ENABLED` to the literal `"false"`, and the standalone assertion's own docstring said why: *"production must not be serving MCP traffic until the pre-launch entitlement audit has run."* That audit is the same three items in this MR's Known Gaps.

Rather than edit the assertion straight through, I stopped and confirmed with the operator that the gaps are being accepted as risk rather than closed first. `d7307da46` updates both assertions and renames `test_production_is_disabled` → `test_production_is_enabled`, with a docstring recording the date, this MR, and the accepted gaps — so the guard still does its job on the *next* change to this value, and the next reader sees the reasoning rather than a literal that silently flipped.

All 10 jobs pass.

| ✓ Silently Applied | 1 |
| ✗ Not Applied | 0 |

All flagged findings have been addressed. MR approved.
